description: Header file defining the FastSymbolizer class for symbolizing addresses in libraries, including functions for parsing debug info and line number programs, and generating frames with symbolized information.

classes.name: FastSymbolizer
classes.description: Class responsible for symbolizing addresses within libraries, managing debug info parsing, and generating frames with function and source location info.

methods.name: symbolize
methods.description: Generates a frame with symbolized function name, filename, and line number for a given library and offset.

methods.name: warnings
methods.description: Returns the list of warning messages generated during symbolization.

methods.name: parseDebugInfo
methods.description: Parses debug information from a Sections object to populate line number programs.

methods.name: getOrCreateSections
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Sections object for a given library, parsing its debug info.

methods.name: findLine
methods.description: Finds the source filename and line number for a given offset within a Sections object.
